sermon.title: Seven Types of Persons Reacting to the Gospel of Christ 09/08/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer uses Stephen to show how people react to the gospel. Some dispute and lie, some resist the Holy Ghost, some reject baptism, many are unlearned or self-seeking. Others care but are still learning, and some lead, loving the enemy while exposing truth. God’s rain softens hard ground until Christ shines fully in us.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.
